text.text: The Plated Helmet is head armor forged from plates. It protects against damage and can be modified with traits like any tool.
Crafted from a single plating in the Tool Station or Tool Forge.

properties: Material determines durability, defense, toughness and knockback resistance
Stats: Hardness (less durability loss), Environmental Protection, Weight and Ricochet
Supports modifiers: Protection variants, Feather Falling, Double Jump
